info.what: A network of servers around the world that keeps copies of your files close to users.
info.why: Images, videos and scripts load much faster from nearby, and your own servers handle far less traffic.
info.analogy: Local warehouses stocking popular items so deliveries arrive quickly.

samples.caption: A nearby copy answers: the origin never sees it
samples.code:
GET /images/logo.png
Host: cdn.example.com

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Cache-Control: max-age=86400
X-Cache: HIT
Age: 3150

samples.caption: How long each file is kept: versioned names can stay a year, personal data never
